e.title: 尼日利亚海洋保险核心引擎：设计信条第一条写「到处 fail-closed」，并明说「成功从不被伪造」、再保险分保「省略而非留桩」，且以数据库约束拒绝提交任何不平衡的分录
e.title_en: A Nigerian marine insurance core engine whose first design principle is fail-closed everywhere, which states that success is never fabricated, declares reinsurance ceding omitted rather than stubbed, and has the database refuse to commit any unbalanced journal
e.title_hk: 尼日利亞海洋保險核心引擎：設計信條第一條寫「到處 fail-closed」，並明說「成功從不被偽造」、再保險分保「省略而非留樁」，且以數據庫約束拒絕提交任何不平衡的分錄
e.summary: 一个面向尼日利亚 BlueEconomy 公私合营平台的海洋保险引擎：产品目录、服务端确定性保费计算、报价→承保（maker-checker 双人控制）→以 W3C VC 2.0 凭证签发保单、批单、失效／注销（配位串状态表撤销）与双分录结算的理赔；其设计信条逐条可核对——到处 fail-closed（启动即拒绝占位签名密钥、全局可读的密钥文件、畸形的策略配置；未配置的集成报告不可用并返回 503，而文档明言「成功从不被伪造」）；金额只用整数最小币种单位、费率与风险因子只用基点，「任何地方都没有浮点数」，且客户端自报的保费总额对不上就被拒；不变式由数据库强制（checker ≠ maker 的 CHECK 约束、哈希链式追加审计、触发器拒绝 UPDATE/DELETE、以及一个延迟约束触发器拒绝提交任何借贷不平衡的分录）；再保险分保功能「省略而非留桩」，能力注册表会以明确的「未实现」理由报告其不可用
e.summary_hk: 一個面向尼日利亞 BlueEconomy 公私營合營平台的海洋保險引擎：產品目錄、服務端確定性保費計算、報價→承保（maker-checker 雙人控制）→以 W3C VC 2.0 憑證簽發保單、批單、失效／註銷（配位串狀態表撤銷）與雙分錄結算的理賠；其設計信條逐條可核對——到處 fail-closed（啟動即拒絕佔位簽名密鑰、全局可讀的密鑰文件、畸形的策略配置；未配置的集成報告不可用並返回 503，而文檔明言「成功從不被偽造」）；金額只用整數最小幣種單位、費率與風險因子只用基點，「任何地方都沒有浮點數」，且客戶端自報的保費總額對不上就被拒；不變式由數據庫強制（checker ≠ maker 的 CHECK 約束、哈希鏈式追加審計、觸發器拒絕 UPDATE/DELETE、以及一個延遲約束觸發器拒絕提交任何借貸不平衡的分錄）；再保險分保功能「省略而非留樁」，能力註冊表會以明確的「未實現」理由報告其不可用
e.summary_en: A marine insurance engine for Nigeria’s BlueEconomy public-private partnership platform: product catalogue, deterministic server-side premium rating, a quote to bind (maker-checker dual control) to issuance flow that issues policies as W3C VC 2.0 credentials, endorsements, lapse and cancellation with bitstring status-list revocation, and claims settled by double entry; its design doctrine is stated point by point and is checkable — fail-closed everywhere (boot refuses placeholder signing keys, world-readable key files and malformed policy or adapter configuration; unconfigured integrations report unavailable and return 503, with the documentation stating that success is never fabricated); money is integer minor units only and rates and risk factors are basis points, with no floats anywhere, and a client-supplied premium total is rejected on mismatch; invariants are enforced by the database (a CHECK constraint for checker not equal to maker, an append-only hash-chained audit with UPDATE and DELETE rejected by trigger, and a deferred constraint trigger that rejects the commit of any unbalanced journal); and reinsurance ceding is declared omitted rather than stubbed, with the capabilities registry reporting it unavailable for an explicit not-implemented reason
e.body:
**blueeconomy-marine-insurance**（仓库 `munisp/blueeconomy-insurance`）**是一个面向尼日利亚 BlueEconomy 公私合营（PPP）平台的**海洋保险（marine insurance）核心引擎****：**实测 ★0、fork 0、许可 Apache-2.0（`LICENSE` 经 raw 实测存在，11,358 字节，首行「Apache License」）、主语言 Python、仓库体量 157 KB、创建于 2026-08-31、最后推送 2026-09-09**（**均 GitHub API 实测值；创建在解冻窗口之前，推送落在窗口之内**）、**无 topics**；**README 实测 4,316 字节（英语）**；**仓库实测共 100 个条目**。**其自述范围逐字为**：**「Marine insurance engine for the BlueEconomy PPP platform: **product catalogue, deterministic server-side premium rating, quote → bind (maker-checker) → policy issuance as W3C VC 2.0 credentials, endorsements, lapse/cancel with bitstring status-list revocation, and claims with double-entry settlement**.」**。本条目属于本轮主题**「宁可拒绝，也不假装」**中的**第二种，也是四条里把这条原则写得最系统、最像工程信条的一条**——**它整节叫「Design doctrine」（设计信条）**，**而第一条就是「到处 fail-closed」**。

可核实信息（**均 README 与仓库实测**）：⭐⭐⭐ **「Design doctrine」第一节逐字，是本轮主题最完整的单段表述**——**逐字为**：**「**Fail-closed everywhere.** **Boot refuses placeholder/dummy signing keys, world-readable key files, malformed PBAC policies and malformed partner adapter config.** Unconfigured integrations report unavailable via `GET /v1/capabilities` and return 503 from dependent routes — **success is never fabricated**. Partner-insurer calls to an unconfigured adapter fail with `ADAPTER_UNCONFIGURED` **before any network I/O**.」**⭐⭐⭐ **这一段里三条各自拒绝一件不同的事**：**① **拒绝启动**——占位或伪签名密钥、**全局可读的密钥文件**、畸形的策略（PBAC）与畸形的合作方适配器配置，**都在启动阶段就被拒**（**「world-readable key files」是一条很具体的文件权限检查，值得单独记住**）；**② **「success is never fabricated」（成功从不被伪造）**——**未配置的集成以能力注册表报告不可用、依赖它的路由返回 503，**而不是返回一个看起来成功的空结果****；**③ **「before any network I/O」（在任何网络 I/O 之前）**——**对未配置适配器的调用**先失败、不发生请求****（**⭐ 即**不发出去再报模糊的错**，而是**根本不发**）。**② ⭐⭐⭐ **第二节把「钱」写成了类型问题，并给出了一句最直接的理由**——**逐字为**：**「**Integer money only.** All amounts are integer kobo (1 NGN = 100 kobo); all rates and risk factors are basis points. **No floats anywhere**; client-supplied premium totals are rejected on mismatch (`client-total-rejected`).」**⭐⭐⭐ **两件事值得分开记**：**① **金额用整数最小币种单位（kobo，1 奈拉 = 100 kobo）、费率与风险因子用基点**，**并明言「任何地方都没有浮点数」****——**这是把**浮点误差**这一类**不报错、只在极少数情况下让数字差一分钱**的失败，从根上排除掉**（**可与第 335 轮 [[uae-health-pricing-model]] 的「当前保费与未来保费分列」并读：**两者都在处理**不会报错却会让数字变味**的问题**）；**② **客户端自报的保费总额若与服务端算出的不符，直接拒绝**（`client-total-rejected`）**⭐⭐⭐ **这一条尤其值得定价方向的同学记住**：**它比「服务端重算一遍」更硬——**客户端报的数与服务端不一致时**交易不成立****（**可与第 334 轮 [[restaurant-insurance-quote]] 的「未来保存报价时须由服务端按输入与规则版本重新计算」并读；**那一条是**应当如此**，这一条是**已经这样拦住了****）。**③ ⭐⭐⭐ **第三节把不变式放进数据库，并具体点名了四处**——**逐字为**：**「**DB-enforced invariants.** CHECK constraints (status enums, **dual control: checker ≠ maker on binds, adjuster assignment and settlement**), unique constraints, **append-only hash-chained audit (trigger-rejected UPDATE/DELETE)**, immutable bind decisions/endorsements/evidence/receipts, and **a deferred constraint trigger that rejects COMMIT of any unbalanced double-entry journal**.」**⭐⭐⭐ **四处各拒绝一件事**：**① **双人控制由 CHECK 约束保证**（**承保、理算人指派与结算三处的 checker 不得等于 maker**）——**即**四眼原则不是流程规定而是表结构约束****；**② **追加式哈希链审计**，**UPDATE 与 DELETE 被触发器拒绝****；**③ **承保决定、批单、证据、收据不可变****；**④ **一个延迟约束触发器**拒绝提交任何借贷不平衡的分录****⭐⭐⭐ **第 ④ 条是本条最值得单独记住的一处**：**它把「分录必须平衡」这条会计不变式放在**COMMIT 时刻由数据库拒绝**，而不是放在应用代码里检查****——**即**账不平，事务就提交不了****（**⚠️ 本词条**未读任何 SQL 或迁移脚本**，**故**不主张这四个触发器／约束确实已实现或确实生效**）。**④ ⭐⭐⭐ **「省略而非留桩」是本轮主题最锋利的一句，且它点名的是**一个缺失的整块功能****——**逐字为**：**「**Reinsurance/ceding** — **Omitted, not stubbed.** There is no ceding ledger in this service; **the capabilities registry reports `reinsurance.ceding` unavailable with an explicit "not implemented" reason**. Partner gateways exist for evidence exchange only and are fail-closed when unconfigured.」**⭐⭐⭐ **「Omitted, not stubbed」（省略，而不是留桩）**：**即**没做的功能不在代码里留一个看起来能用的空壳，而是**在机器可读的能力注册表里报为不可用并附明确的「未实现」理由****——**这本条目的判断是：它与本轮其余三条同属一种姿态**——**宁可让调用方拿到一个明确的「这里没有」，也不要让它拿到一个假的「有」**（**⚠️ 本词条**未请求 `/v1/capabilities`**，**故**不主张该注册表当前确实如此报告**）。**⑤ ⭐⭐⭐ **整张 API 路由表本身带**权限标注**，这在同类文档里不常见**——**逐字实测其「Surface」表按六区列出**：**Products／Quotes／Policies／Claims／Integrations／Ops**；**其中两处带明确标注**：**「`GET /v1/status-list/{purpose}`（**public**）」**与**「`GET /v1/aggregates/portfolio`（**regulator, `insurer-aggregator` role**）」**⭐⭐ **即**哪一条路由对公众开放、哪一条需要监管方角色**，**写在了路由表里而不是别处****（**对做保险系统的同学：**把授权需求与接口清单放在一起，评审时才不用另找一份权限矩阵**）。**⑥ ⭐⭐ **报价与理赔两条流都把「提议」与「决定」拆成了两个路由**——**逐字为**：**报价侧** **「`POST ...:bind`、`POST ...:bind-decision`、`POST ...:issue`」**；**理赔侧** **「`...:propose-adjuster`、`...:confirm-adjuster`、`...:propose-settlement`、`...:approve-settlement`、`...:reject`」**⭐⭐⭐ **即**双人控制在接口形态上也成立**：**提出动作的人与确认动作的人是两次不同的调用**（**而第三节的 CHECK 约束保证这两个调用背后不是同一个人**）**——**接口与数据库两处同时表达同一条控制**。**⑦ ⭐⭐ **另外三处可核实的工程细节**：**① **事件层**逐字为**「**Envelope v1.0 events.** FHIR R4 message Bundle + JWS compact EdDSA over RFC 8785 JCS, `kid = "insurance-<epoch>"`. Published via the **transactional outbox**」**，**并列出五个事件名**（`insurance.policy.v1`、`insurance.policy-endorsed.v1`、`insurance.policy-cancelled.v1`、`insurance.claim.v1`、`insurance.claim-paid.v1`）**⭐ 即**事件走事务性发件箱，与业务写入同一事务****；**② **保单凭证的**最小披露****——逐字为**「**Policy credentials are minimal-disclosure: no premiums, values or assured identifiers inside the credential.**」**⭐ 即**一张可验证凭证里不放保费、保额与被保险人标识****（**Vault 与撤销用 `eddsa-jcs-2022` 证明与配位串状态表**）；**③ **保单号带 Luhn mod-34 校验位**且**「gated before any database lookup」**（**格式为 `NG-<KIND3>-<YYYY>-<SEQ10>-<CHECK>`**）**⭐⭐ **即**格式不合法的保单号在查库之前就被拒**——**又一次「在任何 I/O 之前」**。**⑧ ⭐⭐⭐ **本条目最有力的可核实证据在测试目录里：其信条是**被测**的，不只是被写的**——**实测 `tests/unit/` 下 7 个模块**（`test_envelope`、`test_jcs`、`test_pbac`、`test_policy_numbers`、`test_rating`、`test_statuslist`、`test_vc`）**与 `tests/integration/` 下 6 个模块**（`test_claims`、⭐ **`test_failclosed.py`**、`test_integrations`、`test_lifecycle`、`test_premium_economics`、⭐ **`test_race.py`**）**⭐⭐⭐ **其中 `test_failclosed.py` 直接把「到处 fail-closed」当作集成测试的对象**，**而 `test_race.py` 针对并发竞争**——**⭐ 对做核心系统的同学，这两个测试文件名的存在说明**「fail-closed」在这里是一个**有验收标准的断言**，而不是一句形容词**（**⚠️ 本词条**未运行任何测试**，**故**不主张它们通过，**也未读其内容**）。**⑨ ⭐ **其开发流程逐字，含两处便于自学的地方**：**逐字为** **「`pip install -e ‘.[dev]’ pgserver`   # **pgserver bundles a REAL PostgreSQL**」**、**「`pytest tests/unit -q`   # pure unit tests」**、**「`pytest tests/integration -q`   # real PostgreSQL (pgserver or INSURANCE_TEST_DATABASE_URL)」**、**「`ruff check src tests && mypy src」****⭐⭐ **即**单元测试是纯的、集成测试跑在**真的 PostgreSQL** 上，**而本地可以用 `pgserver` 直接把真库跑起来**；**并逐字为** **「Configuration is 12-factor env-only (`INSURANCE_*`); see `src/insurance/config.py`. **Secrets never have defaults and are never committed.**」**⭐⭐ **「密钥永不带默认值、永不提交」与第一节的「拒绝全局可读的密钥文件」是同一条纪律的两端**。**⑩ ⭐⭐ **另有一处结构细节**：**实测仓库里有 `keys/README.md`**——**即**挂载密钥的那个目录里放了一份说明****（**与「拒绝全局可读的密钥文件」配套：**这个目录是干什么的、里面应该有什么，写在它自己旁边**）。**⑪ ⭐ 可与本站海洋险、治理、开源保险核心与结算条目并读**：[[tokio-marine]]、[[insurance-governance]]、[[titanium-insurance-core]]、[[openinsurance]]、[[openimis]]、[[cloud-itonami-isic-6520]]、[[quorumforge]]、[[reinsurance-contracts-repository]]、[[payout-assurance-standard]]、[[bind-standard]]、[[acord]]、[[verified-reserving]]。

⚠️ **如实标注**：**① ⚠️⚠️ **本次**未读一行源码、未读一份迁移脚本、未运行任何测试****——**故本词条所述的四处数据库不变式、五条设计信条、事件封装与凭证格式，**全部只记录为 README 如此声明****；**⭐ 本词条**已实测的只是**这些机制**各自对应的文件或测试确实存在****（**`src/insurance/config.py`、`tests/integration/test_failclosed.py`、`tests/integration/test_race.py` 等**），**⚠️ 但**文件存在不等于其中实现了 README 所述的约束****——**这是本条目最需要后续核实的一处**。**② ⚠️⚠️ **未核实**其「确定性服务端保费计算」的具体算法**——**即**费率的计算口径、风险因子的取值与应用方式、以及「确定性」是否在数值上真的成立****（**本次未读 `test_rating.py` 或任何评分代码**）；**⚠️ 也**未核实**其「整数 kobo ＋ 基点、无浮点」是否在全部代码路径中成立**（**未运行 `mypy`／`ruff`，未做静态检查**）。**③ ⚠️⚠️ **未核实**其海洋险的险种设定是否与尼日利亚现行监管要求或任何保险公司的实际条款一致**——**本次未查尼日利亚保险监管机构（NAICOM）的任何规则、也未查任何条款或费率表**；**⭐ 尤其**不主张**其产品目录、费率结构或承保规则可用于任何真实的海洋险定价、承保或监管报送**。**④ ⚠️⭐ **未核实**其 ISR 结果账本集成**——**README 逐字描述了从另一服务（blueeconomy-maritime-intelligence）的结果账本消费保费差额证据、按挂载密钥目录验签、以环境变量**钉住摘要**、**防重放**、存储后不可变，并以**已确认的保费差额基点之和**作为走廊航线风险**（**按费率表设上限**）**——**⚠️ 本次**未读任何集成代码、未请求任何接口**，**故**不转述其证据格式、验证流程或对费率的实际影响**。**⑤ ⚠️⭐ **未核实**其 W3C 可验证凭证部分**——**包括 `eddsa-jcs-2022` 证明、配位串状态表撤销、Luhn mod-34 校验位与「最小披露」**；**⚠️ 本次**未做任何密码学验证**，**故**不主张其密码学实现正确或安全**（**本条目**不建议**任何人据此实现生产系统**）。**⑥ ⚠️ **本次核实的是**仓库元数据、README（4,316 字节）全文、以及仓库全部 100 个条目的文件清单**，**并核实了根 `LICENSE` 的存在与首行**（11,358 字节，Apache License）；⭐⭐ **但**未克隆、未安装 Python 或 PostgreSQL、未运行 `pytest`／`ruff`／`mypy`、未启动服务、**未请求任何路由**（**含 `/v1/capabilities`**）、**未读 `src/` 下任何模块源码、未读任何测试文件内容、未读任何迁移脚本**、未读 `pyproject.toml`、未读 `keys/README.md` 的内容****；**⑦ ⭐⭐ **未核实**其与 BlueEconomy PPP 平台及 blueeconomy-maritime-intelligence 的关系**——**即**这是一个真实项目的一部分，还是一个概念演示****；**⚠️ 本次**未查该平台**，**故**不主张该项目已部署、已上线或已被任何机构采用**；**⭐ README 中出现的**机构性词汇（监管方角色 `insurer-aggregator`、奈拉计价、PPP 平台**）**不构成任何机构背书的证据**。**⑧ ⭐ ⚠️ **未核实**其「再保险分保省略而非留桩」是否确实如此**——**⚠️ 该声明依赖**能力注册表的实际响应**，**本次**未请求该接口**；**⚠️ 但本词条如实记下这一点：它的**声明方式本身**值得记，**而不只是声明的内容**。**⑨ ⭐ ★0、fork 0、创建于 2026-08-31、推送于 2026-09-09**，**关注度极低**，**不主张其成熟度、正确性或已被采用**；**⑩ ⭐ 无 topics**；**⑪ **README 为英语**——**本词条已如实记入，**本次未核实是否有其他语言版本**。**核实说明**：`https://api.github.com/repos/munisp/blueeconomy-insurance` 于 2026-09-11 经 GitHub API 实测读取（含许可字段 Apache-2.0、★数、fork 数、语言、体量、创建／推送时间与 topics）；README 4,316 字节经 `raw.githubusercontent.com` 实测逐字核对；**仓库全部 100 个条目**经下载 `codeload.github.com` tarball 后以 `tar tz` 列出核对；**根 `LICENSE`（11,358 字节，首行 Apache License）经 raw 实测读取**；**未克隆、未安装、未运行任何命令、未启动服务、未请求任何路由、未读任何源码或测试内容、未读任何迁移脚本、未读 `keys/README.md` 内容、未做任何密码学验证**。

**blueeconomy-marine-insurance**（倉庫 `munisp/blueeconomy-insurance`）**是一個面向尼日利亞 BlueEconomy 公私營合營（PPP）平台的**海洋保險（marine insurance）核心引擎****：**實測 ★0、fork 0、許可 Apache-2.0（`LICENSE` 經 raw 實測存在，11,358 位元組，首行「Apache License」）、主語言 Python、體量 157 KB、創建於 2026-08-31、最後推送 2026-09-09**（**創建在解凍窗口之前，推送落在窗口之內**）、**無 topics**；**README 實測 4,316 位元組（英語）**；**倉庫實測共 100 個條目**。**其自述範圍逐字為**：**「Marine insurance engine for the BlueEconomy PPP platform: **product catalogue, deterministic server-side premium rating, quote → bind (maker-checker) → policy issuance as W3C VC 2.0 credentials, endorsements, lapse/cancel with bitstring status-list revocation, and claims with double-entry settlement**.」**。本條目屬本輪主題**「寧可拒絕，也不假裝」**中的**第二種，也是四條裡把這條原則寫得最系統、最像工程信條的一條**——**它整節叫「Design doctrine」（設計信條），而第一條就是「到處 fail-closed」**。

可核實資訊（**均 README 與倉庫實測**）：⭐⭐⭐ **「Design doctrine」第一節逐字，是本輪主題最完整的單段表述**——**逐字為**：**「**Fail-closed everywhere.** **Boot refuses placeholder/dummy signing keys, world-readable key files, malformed PBAC policies and malformed partner adapter config.** Unconfigured integrations report unavailable via `GET /v1/capabilities` and return 503 from dependent routes — **success is never fabricated**. Partner-insurer calls to an unconfigured adapter fail with `ADAPTER_UNCONFIGURED` **before any network I/O**.」**⭐⭐⭐ **這一段裡三條各拒絕一件不同的事**：**① **拒絕啟動**——佔位或偽簽名密鑰、**全局可讀的密鑰文件**、畸形的策略（PBAC）與畸形的合作方適配器配置；**② **「success is never fabricated」（成功從不被偽造）**——**未配置的集成以能力註冊表報告不可用、依賴它的路由返回 503，而不是返回一個看起來成功的空結果****；**③ **「before any network I/O」（在任何網路 I/O 之前）**——**對未配置適配器的調用**先失敗、不發生請求****（**⭐ 即**不發出去再報模糊的錯，而是根本不發****）。**② ⭐⭐⭐ **第二節把「錢」寫成了類型問題**——**逐字**：**「**Integer money only.** All amounts are integer kobo (1 NGN = 100 kobo); all rates and risk factors are basis points. **No floats anywhere**; client-supplied premium totals are rejected on mismatch (`client-total-rejected`).」**⭐⭐⭐ **兩件事分開記**：**① **金額用整數最小幣種單位（kobo）、費率與風險因子用基點**，**並明言「任何地方都沒有浮點數」**——**這是把**浮點誤差**這類**不報錯、只在極少數情況下讓數字差一分錢**的失敗從根上排除掉****（**可與第 335 輪 [[uae-health-pricing-model]] 的「當前保費與未來保費分列」並讀**）；**② **客戶端自報的保費總額若與服務端算出的不符，直接拒絕**（`client-total-rejected`）**⭐⭐⭐ **這一條尤其值得定價方向的同學記住**：**它比「服務端重算一遍」更硬——**客戶端報的數與服務端不一致時**交易不成立****（**可與第 334 輪 [[restaurant-insurance-quote]] 並讀：那條是**應當如此**，這條是**已經這樣攔住了****）。**③ ⭐⭐⭐ **第三節把不變式放進數據庫，並具體點名四處**——**逐字**：**「**DB-enforced invariants.** CHECK constraints (status enums, **dual control: checker ≠ maker on binds, adjuster assignment and settlement**), unique constraints, **append-only hash-chained audit (trigger-rejected UPDATE/DELETE)**, immutable bind decisions/endorsements/evidence/receipts, and **a deferred constraint trigger that rejects COMMIT of any unbalanced double-entry journal**.」**⭐⭐⭐ **四處各拒絕一件事**：**① **雙人控制由 CHECK 約束保證**（**承保、理算人指派與結算三處的 checker 不得等於 maker**）——**即**四眼原則不是流程規定而是表結構約束****；**② **追加式哈希鏈審計**，**UPDATE 與 DELETE 被觸發器拒絕****；**③ **承保決定、批單、證據、收據不可變****；**④ **一個延遲約束觸發器拒絕提交任何借貸不平衡的分錄****⭐⭐⭐ **第 ④ 條最值得單獨記住**：**它把「分錄必須平衡」放在**COMMIT 時刻由數據庫拒絕**，而不是放在應用代碼裡檢查****——**即**賬不平，事務就提交不了****（**⚠️ 未讀任何 SQL 或遷移腳本，故不主張這四個觸發器／約束確實已實現或生效**）。**④ ⭐⭐⭐ **「省略而非留樁」是本輪主題最鋒利的一句，且它點名的是**一整塊缺失的功能****——**逐字**：**「**Reinsurance/ceding** — **Omitted, not stubbed.** There is no ceding ledger in this service; **the capabilities registry reports `reinsurance.ceding` unavailable with an explicit "not implemented" reason**. Partner gateways exist for evidence exchange only and are fail-closed when unconfigured.」**⭐⭐⭐ **「Omitted, not stubbed」**：**即**沒做的功能不在代碼裡留一個看起來能用的空殼，而是在機器可讀的能力註冊表裡報為不可用並附明確的「未實現」理由****（**⚠️ 未請求 `/v1/capabilities`，故不主張該註冊表當前確實如此報告**）。**⑤ ⭐⭐⭐ **整張 API 路由表本身帶**權限標註****——**逐字實測其「Surface」表按六區列出**：**Products／Quotes／Policies／Claims／Integrations／Ops**；**其中兩處帶明確標註**：**「`GET /v1/status-list/{purpose}`（**public**）」**與**「`GET /v1/aggregates/portfolio`（**regulator, `insurer-aggregator` role**）」**⭐⭐ **即**哪一條路由對公眾開放、哪一條需要監管方角色，寫在了路由表裡而不是別處****。**⑥ ⭐⭐ **報價與理賠兩條流都把「提議」與「決定」拆成兩個路由**——**報價側** **「`POST ...:bind`、`POST ...:bind-decision`、`POST ...:issue`」**；**理賠側** **「`...:propose-adjuster`、`...:confirm-adjuster`、`...:propose-settlement`、`...:approve-settlement`、`...:reject`」**⭐⭐⭐ **即**雙人控制在接口形態上也成立**：**提出動作的人與確認動作的人是兩次不同的調用**（**而第三節的 CHECK 約束保證這兩個調用背後不是同一個人**）。**⑦ ⭐⭐ **另外三處可核實的細節**：**① **事件層**逐字**「**Envelope v1.0 events.** FHIR R4 message Bundle + JWS compact EdDSA over RFC 8785 JCS, `kid = "insurance-<epoch>"`. Published via the **transactional outbox**」**並列出五個事件名**⭐ **即**事件走事務性發件箱，與業務寫入同一事務****；**② **保單憑證的**最小披露****——逐字**「**Policy credentials are minimal-disclosure: no premiums, values or assured identifiers inside the credential.**」**；**③ **保單號帶 Luhn mod-34 校驗位**且**「gated before any database lookup」**（**格式 `NG-<KIND3>-<YYYY>-<SEQ10>-<CHECK>`**）**⭐⭐ **即**格式不合法的保單號在查庫之前就被拒**——**又一次「在任何 I/O 之前」**。**⑧ ⭐⭐⭐ **最有力的可核實證據在測試目錄：其信條是**被測**的，不只是被寫的**——**實測 `tests/unit/` 下 7 個模組**（`test_envelope`、`test_jcs`、`test_pbac`、`test_policy_numbers`、`test_rating`、`test_statuslist`、`test_vc`）**與 `tests/integration/` 下 6 個模組**（`test_claims`、⭐ **`test_failclosed.py`**、`test_integrations`、`test_lifecycle`、`test_premium_economics`、⭐ **`test_race.py`**）**⭐⭐⭐ **其中 `test_failclosed.py` 直接把「到處 fail-closed」當作整合測試的對象**，**而 `test_race.py` 針對並發競爭**——**⭐ 即**「fail-closed」在這裡是一個**有驗收標準的斷言**，而不是一句形容詞****（**⚠️ 未運行任何測試，故不主張它們通過，也未讀其內容**）。**⑨ ⭐ **開發流程逐字，含兩處便於自學的地方**：**「`pip install -e ‘.[dev]’ pgserver`   # **pgserver bundles a REAL PostgreSQL**」「`pytest tests/unit -q`   # pure unit tests」「`pytest tests/integration -q`   # real PostgreSQL (pgserver or INSURANCE_TEST_DATABASE_URL)」「`ruff check src tests && mypy src」****⭐⭐ **即**單元測試是純的、整合測試跑在**真的 PostgreSQL** 上，本地可用 `pgserver` 直接把真庫跑起來**；**並逐字** **「Configuration is 12-factor env-only (`INSURANCE_*`); see `src/insurance/config.py`. **Secrets never have defaults and are never committed.**」**⭐⭐ **與第一節的「拒絕全局可讀的密鑰文件」是同一條紀律的兩端**。**⑩ ⭐⭐ **另有一處結構細節**：**實測倉庫裡有 `keys/README.md`**——**即**掛載密鑰的那個目錄裡放了一份說明****。**⑪ ⭐ 可與 [[tokio-marine]]、[[insurance-governance]]、[[titanium-insurance-core]]、[[openinsurance]]、[[openimis]]、[[cloud-itonami-isic-6520]]、[[quorumforge]]、[[reinsurance-contracts-repository]]、[[payout-assurance-standard]]、[[bind-standard]]、[[acord]]、[[verified-reserving]] 並讀**。

⚠️ **如實標注**：**① ⚠️⚠️ **本次**未讀一行源碼、未讀一份遷移腳本、未運行任何測試****——**故所述四處數據庫不變式、五條設計信條、事件封裝與憑證格式**全部只記錄為 README 如此聲明****；**⭐ 本詞條**已實測的只是**這些機制各自對應的文件或測試確實存在****（**`src/insurance/config.py`、`tests/integration/test_failclosed.py`、`tests/integration/test_race.py` 等**），**⚠️ 但**文件存在不等於其中實現了 README 所述的約束****——**這是本條目最需要後續核實的一處**。**② ⚠️⚠️ **未核實**其「確定性服務端保費計算」的具體算法**（**未讀 `test_rating.py` 或任何評分代碼**）；**⚠️ 也**未核實**其「整數 kobo ＋ 基點、無浮點」是否在全部代碼路徑中成立**（**未運行 `mypy`／`ruff`，未做靜態檢查**）。**③ ⚠️⚠️ **未核實**其海洋險的險種設定是否與尼日利亞現行監管要求或任何保險公司的實際條款一致**——**本次未查尼日利亞保險監管機構（NAICOM）的任何規則、也未查任何條款或費率表**；**⭐ 尤其**不主張**其產品目錄、費率結構或承保規則可用於任何真實的海洋險定價、承保或監管報送**。**④ ⚠️⭐ **未核實**其 ISR 結果賬本集成**——**README 逐字描述了從另一服務消費保費差額證據、按掛載密鑰目錄驗簽、以環境變數**釘住摘要**、**防重放**、存儲後不可變，並以**已確認的保費差額基點之和**作為走廊航線風險**（**按費率表設上限**）**——**⚠️ 本次**未讀任何集成代碼、未請求任何接口****。**⑤ ⚠️⭐ **未核實**其 W3C 可驗證憑證部分**（**`eddsa-jcs-2022` 證明、配位串狀態表撤銷、Luhn mod-34 校驗位與最小披露**）；**⚠️ 本次**未做任何密碼學驗證**，**故**不主張其密碼學實現正確或安全****（**本條目**不建議**任何人據此實現生產系統**）。**⑥ ⚠️ **本次核實到**倉庫元數據、README 全文、以及全部 100 個條目的文件清單**，**並核實根 `LICENSE` 的存在與首行**；⭐⭐ **但**未克隆、未安裝 Python 或 PostgreSQL、未運行 `pytest`／`ruff`／`mypy`、未啟動服務、**未請求任何路由**（**含 `/v1/capabilities`**）、**未讀 `src/` 下任何源碼、未讀任何測試內容、未讀任何遷移腳本**、未讀 `pyproject.toml`、未讀 `keys/README.md` 內容****；**⑦ ⭐⭐ **未核實**其與 BlueEconomy PPP 平台及 blueeconomy-maritime-intelligence 的關係**——**即**這是一個真實項目的一部分，還是一個概念演示****；**⚠️ 本次**未查該平台**，**故**不主張該項目已部署、已上線或已被任何機構採用**；**⭐ README 中出現的**機構性詞彙不構成任何機構背書的證據****。**⑧ ⭐ ⚠️ **未核實**其「再保險分保省略而非留樁」是否確實如此**——**⚠️ 該聲明依賴**能力註冊表的實際響應**，**本次**未請求該接口**；**⚠️ 但本詞條如實記下：它的**聲明方式本身**值得記**。**⑨ ⭐ ★0、fork 0、創建於 2026-08-31、推送於 2026-09-09**，**不主張其成熟度／正確性／已被採用**；**⑩ ⭐ 無 topics**；**⑪ **README 為英語**——**已如實記入，本次未核實是否有其他語言版本**。**核實說明**：`https://api.github.com/repos/munisp/blueeconomy-insurance` 於 2026-09-11 經 GitHub API 實測讀取；README 4,316 位元組經 raw 實測逐字核對；**全部 100 個條目**經下載 tarball 後以 `tar tz` 列出核對；**根 `LICENSE`（11,358 位元組，首行 Apache License）經 raw 實測讀取**；**未克隆、未安裝、未運行任何命令、未啟動服務、未請求任何路由、未讀任何源碼或測試內容、未讀任何遷移腳本、未讀 `keys/README.md` 內容、未做任何密碼學驗證**。

**blueeconomy-marine-insurance** (repository `munisp/blueeconomy-insurance`) **is a marine insurance core engine for Nigeria’s BlueEconomy public-private partnership (PPP) platform**: **measured ★0, 0 forks, licence Apache-2.0 (`LICENSE` measured present by raw probe at 11,358 bytes, first line "Apache License"), Python as the primary language, a 157 KB repository, created 2026-08-31 and last pushed 2026-09-09** (**both GitHub API measurements; creation before the thaw window, push inside it**), **no topics**; **the README measures 4,316 bytes and is in English**; **the repository measures 100 entries in total**. **Its stated scope reads verbatim**: **"Marine insurance engine for the BlueEconomy PPP platform: **product catalogue, deterministic server-side premium rating, quote → bind (maker-checker) → policy issuance as W3C VC 2.0 credentials, endorsements, lapse/cancel with bitstring status-list revocation, and claims with double-entry settlement**."** It is the second of this round’s four takes on **rather refusing than pretending**, **and the one that states the principle most systematically, as an engineering creed** — **an entire section is titled "Design doctrine", and its first entry is fail-closed everywhere**.

Verifiable details (**all read verbatim from the README and measured in the repository**): ⭐⭐⭐ **The first design-doctrine entry is verbatim, and is the fullest single statement of this round’s theme** — **verbatim**: **"**Fail-closed everywhere.** **Boot refuses placeholder/dummy signing keys, world-readable key files, malformed PBAC policies and malformed partner adapter config.** Unconfigured integrations report unavailable via `GET /v1/capabilities` and return 503 from dependent routes — **success is never fabricated**. Partner-insurer calls to an unconfigured adapter fail with `ADAPTER_UNCONFIGURED` **before any network I/O**."** ⭐⭐⭐ **Three distinct refusals sit in that paragraph**: **first, a refusal to start** — placeholder or dummy signing keys, **world-readable key files**, malformed policy (PBAC) and malformed partner adapter configuration are all rejected at boot; **second, "success is never fabricated"** — **an unconfigured integration reports itself unavailable in the capabilities registry and dependent routes return 503, rather than returning a plausible-looking empty success**; **third, "before any network I/O"** — **a call to an unconfigured adapter fails first and the request is never made** (⭐ **rather than sending it and then reporting a vague error, it is not sent at all**). **② ⭐⭐⭐ The second entry turns money into a type question** — **verbatim**: **"**Integer money only.** All amounts are integer kobo (1 NGN = 100 kobo); all rates and risk factors are basis points. **No floats anywhere**; client-supplied premium totals are rejected on mismatch (`client-total-rejected`)."** ⭐⭐⭐ **Two things belong apart**: **first, amounts are integer minor units (kobo) and rates and risk factors are basis points, with "no floats anywhere" stated outright** — **this removes at the root a class of failure that raises no error and only occasionally leaves a figure a penny out** (**readable with round 335’s [[uae-health-pricing-model]]**); **second, a client-supplied premium total that disagrees with the server’s is rejected outright** (`client-total-rejected`) ⭐⭐⭐ **and that is worth remembering for anyone working on pricing: it is firmer than "recompute it server-side" — when the client’s number and the server’s disagree, the transaction does not stand** (**readable with round 334’s [[restaurant-insurance-quote]], where server-side recomputation is what *should* happen; here it is what already blocks**). **③ ⭐⭐⭐ The third entry puts invariants in the database and names four of them** — **verbatim**: **"**DB-enforced invariants.** CHECK constraints (status enums, **dual control: checker ≠ maker on binds, adjuster assignment and settlement**), unique constraints, **append-only hash-chained audit (trigger-rejected UPDATE/DELETE)**, immutable bind decisions/endorsements/evidence/receipts, and **a deferred constraint trigger that rejects COMMIT of any unbalanced double-entry journal**."** ⭐⭐⭐ **Four refusals**: **dual control guaranteed by a CHECK constraint** (**checker must not equal maker on binds, adjuster assignment and settlement**) — **the four-eyes principle is a table constraint rather than a procedural rule**; **an append-only hash-chained audit with UPDATE and DELETE rejected by trigger**; **bind decisions, endorsements, evidence and receipts immutable**; **and a deferred constraint trigger rejecting the COMMIT of any unbalanced double-entry journal** ⭐⭐⭐ **the fourth deserves its own sentence: the accounting invariant that a journal must balance is enforced by the database at COMMIT time rather than checked in application code** — **if the books do not balance, the transaction cannot commit** (**⚠️ no SQL or migration script was read, so these four triggers and constraints are not claimed to be implemented or effective**). **④ ⭐⭐⭐ "Omitted, not stubbed" is the sharpest sentence of this round’s theme, and it names a whole missing block of functionality** — **verbatim**: **"**Reinsurance/ceding** — **Omitted, not stubbed.** There is no ceding ledger in this service; **the capabilities registry reports `reinsurance.ceding` unavailable with an explicit "not implemented" reason**. Partner gateways exist for evidence exchange only and are fail-closed when unconfigured."** ⭐⭐⭐ **A feature that does not exist leaves no plausible-looking shell in the code; instead the machine-readable capabilities registry reports it unavailable with an explicit not-implemented reason** (**⚠️ `/v1/capabilities` was not requested, so the registry is not claimed to report this today**). **⑤ ⭐⭐⭐ The API route table itself carries permission annotations, which is uncommon in documentation of this kind** — **its "Surface" table measurably lists six areas**: **Products / Quotes / Policies / Claims / Integrations / Ops**; **two entries carry explicit annotations**: **"`GET /v1/status-list/{purpose}` (**public**)"** and **"`GET /v1/aggregates/portfolio` (**regulator, `insurer-aggregator` role**)"** ⭐⭐ **which route is open to the public and which requires a regulator role is written in the route table rather than somewhere else**. **⑥ ⭐⭐ Both the quoting and the claims flows split "propose" from "decide" into two routes** — **quoting**: **"`POST ...:bind`, `POST ...:bind-decision`, `POST ...:issue`"**; **claims**: **"`...:propose-adjuster`, `...:confirm-adjuster`, `...:propose-settlement`, `...:approve-settlement`, `...:reject`"** ⭐⭐⭐ **dual control therefore holds in the interface shape too: the person proposing an action and the person confirming it are two different calls**, **while the CHECK constraint from the third entry guarantees they are not the same person behind those calls**. **⑦ ⭐⭐ Three further checkable details**: **the event layer** reads verbatim **"**Envelope v1.0 events.** FHIR R4 message Bundle + JWS compact EdDSA over RFC 8785 JCS, `kid = "insurance-<epoch>"`. Published via the **transactional outbox**"**, naming five events — ⭐ **events go through a transactional outbox, in the same transaction as the business write**; **policy credentials are minimal-disclosure** — verbatim **"**Policy credentials are minimal-disclosure: no premiums, values or assured identifiers inside the credential**"**;
